The balance sheet shows adequate near-term liquidity (current ratio 1.44) and a very large retained earnings cushion, but leverage is still fairly high with liabilities at about 78% of assets and only moderate operating profitability (EBIT of 2,660M on 98,585M of assets). On balance, that looks consistent with a lower-tier investment-grade profile rather than a strong single-A credit.

DECISION: BBB-
